ui.video_settings_help: Set up OpenAI Images and ElevenLabs for the social video workflow. New values are saved on this computer. Leave fields blank to keep their current settings. Use a native voice for the narration language.
ui.local_note: Everything runs on this computer. Models are called through the installed command-line tools.
ui.library_lede: Pick a template, give its inputs and run it. Customize a built-in template to make your own copy.
ui.no_my_templates: No templates of your own yet. Open a built-in template and choose 'Customize', or import a YAML file.
ui.customize_as: Make your own copy with the id:
ui.confirm_delete: Delete the template '{id}'? This cannot be undone.
ui.template_invalid: This template is invalid and cannot run.
ui.builtin_readonly_note: Built-in templates are read-only. To change one, make your own copy; later updates of the built-in template never change your copy.
ui.no_providers: No AI tool found. See the Setup tab.
ui.new_run_lede: Give the inputs. Files stay on this computer; only their text is sent to the tools you pick.
ui.runs_lede: Past and current runs. An interrupted run can continue from the steps that did not finish.
ui.confirm_cancel: Stop the run? You can resume it later.
ui.approval_default_text: Read the content below. If you approve, the flow continues; if you reject, this branch stops.
ui.view_prompt: View the instruction sent to the model
ui.editor_lede: The whole file is checked before it is saved; every problem is listed. Shortcut: Ctrl/⌘+S.
ui.graph_after_valid: The flow is drawn here once the file is valid.
ui.import_lede: Choose a YAML file or paste the text. Its id must be new among your templates.
ui.confirm_discard: Unsaved changes will be lost. Continue?
ui.setup_intro: Once on each computer: "Install missing tools" installs the tools that the templates use, and the PDF reader; then you sign in to each tool with your own account.
ui.not_used: No template uses it by default; no sign-in is needed.
ui.not_configured: Not set up for Mehteran: it cannot use this tool.
ui.pdf_uses: Reads PDF files. Not needed for .docx, .epub, .md and .txt.
ui.run_command: To sign in, run this in a terminal: {command}
ui.start_intro: If you use Mehteran for the first time, complete these steps in order. Installation needs no administrator rights.
ui.step_install_hint: Mehteran installs what is needed on this computer, the PDF reader too. No administrator rights are needed.
ui.installing_all: Installing… (this can take a few minutes)
ui.step_signin: Sign in to the tools in use
ui.step_signin_hint: Use the "With … account" button of each tool on the cards below.
ui.watching_signin: Waiting for you to sign in; the status refreshes by itself every few seconds.
ui.setup_banner: The tools are not ready yet. Complete the setup before you start a run.
ui.pick_run: Pick a run on the left. A new run starts from a workflow's "Run" button on the Workflows tab.
ui.first_run_text: Pick a workflow on the Workflows tab and choose "Run": you give its inputs, and the run is followed here live.
ui.monitor_hint: The diagram shows the status of each step live. Click a step to open its outputs in the side panel.
ui.templates_intro: The built-in templates and your own. Search, filter by category, preview, run, or open one in the visual editor.
ui.pick_template: Pick a template on the left.
ui.yaml_editor_hint: Edit the YAML text directly; comments are kept. Shortcut: Ctrl/⌘+S.
ui.workflow_intro: Drag a step from the left onto the canvas, connect it by dragging from an output handle to another step, and set it up in the panel. No YAML needed.
ui.editor_empty_title: Open a workflow or start a new one
ui.editor_empty_text: Open a workflow with "Edit" on the Workflows tab, or start from an empty canvas.
ui.new_intro: The id becomes the file name and does not change later. The name can be anything.
ui.new_id_rule: The id starts with a lower-case letter and has lower-case letters, digits, '-' and '_' (at most 64).
ui.template_exists_ui: A template with the id '{id}' already exists.
ui.auto_arrange_hint: Place the steps automatically in flow order
ui.delete_hint: Delete the selected step or connection (Delete)
ui.drag_to_connect: Drag to another step to connect:
ui.comments_confirm: Comments are kept next to the key or step they belong to. But {count} comment line(s) belong to a step or key that no longer exists and will be lost. Save anyway?
ui.palette_hint: Drag onto the canvas; a click adds it in the middle.
ui.palette_readonly: A built-in template is read-only; use "Customize" to change it.
ui.would_cycle: This connection would make a cycle.
ui.dangling_refs: {nodes} still refers to what was deleted; it stays marked until you reconnect or remove the reference.
ui.model_drop_ai: A model can only be dropped on an AI step.
ui.connection_used: {node} uses this output in: {fields}. If the connection is deleted, these references are marked.
ui.connection_unused: {node} does not refer to this output yet. Select the step and insert it with a reference button.
ui.refs_none: No inputs or earlier steps yet.
ui.model_hint: an input of the run form, or a fixed model
ui.workflow_panel_hint: With no step selected, edit the workflow itself and the inputs of its run form here.
ui.inputs_hint: What the run form asks for. A step uses one with {{inputs.id}} in its text.
ui.outputs_hint: The files shown as download buttons when a run ends.
ui.yaml_tab_hint: Going back to the visual view reads the text on the server; text that cannot be read is not lost, it stays here with its problems. Saving from here keeps comments.
ui.yaml_readonly: The YAML text of the built-in template (read-only).
ui.stale_title: Mehteran was updated; the server behind this window still runs the old code.
ui.stale_how: Close the server's terminal window (or press Ctrl+C there), then start it again: ./mehter ui (Windows: mehter ui) or "Open Mehteran". Then reload this page.
ui.copy_note: You are editing your own copy of "{name}"; the built-in stays as it is. The first Save creates the copy as "{id}".
ui.port_title: The "{port}" output of {node}: drag it to another step to connect
ui.input_title: The input of {node}: connect an output here
ui.yaml_cannot_switch: This text cannot be read; fix it before switching to the visual view.
ui.library_intro: The built-in templates and your own workflows. Open a card to look at it, run it, or edit it.
ui.builtin_edit_note: The built-in template never changes: "Edit" opens your own copy, which joins your workflows at the first save.
ui.node_pick_hint: Select a step in the diagram or the progress list: its outputs, the instruction sent to the model and approvals show here.
ui.saved_draft: Saved as a draft; it can run once its problems are fixed.
ui.draft_hint: {count} problem(s): it is kept as a draft and cannot run until they are fixed.
ui.draft_problems: {count} problem(s): you can save it as a draft; fix them to run it
ui.draft_cannot_run: Draft: it cannot run until its {count} problem(s) are fixed.
ui.files_summary: {count} file(s) ({size}) · at most {max} files, {limit} MB in total
ui.files_too_many: At most {max} files can be chosen.
ui.files_too_large_ui: The files exceed {limit} MB in total.
ui.files_needed: Choose at least one file for '{name}'.
ui.skipped_hint: This step was skipped: it is on a branch that a condition did not take.
ui.local_hint: A model that runs on this computer (Ollama); nothing is sent anywhere.
ui.local_intro: Optional: run models on this computer (Ollama), read scanned PDFs and images (Tesseract OCR), save PDF and EPUB (Typst, Pandoc), write down audio and video (whisper.cpp), repair damaged PDFs (qpdf). Installed only when you ask.
ui.ollama_about: Ollama runs models on this computer. A step picks one as ollama/<model>.
ui.ollama_honest: Local models are good for summaries, classification and drafts; for long or delicate texts they are weaker than Claude and Codex.
ui.ollama_install_source: Source: the official release archive on GitHub; its SHA-256 checksum is verified. No install script is run, no admin rights are needed.
ui.too_big_ram: Too big for this computer: needs {ram} memory, it has {have}.
ui.model_delete_confirm: Delete the model '{name}' from this computer?
ui.no_local_models: No models yet. Download one below.
ui.ollama_not_running: Ollama is not running; the models cannot be listed.
ui.one_pull_note: One model downloads at a time. Names are as in the Ollama library (for example qwen2.5:7b).
ui.ocr_about: Reads scanned PDF pages and images (the Extract document text step, its 'Text recognition' setting).
ui.ocr_install_what: Tesseract {version} with Turkish and English language data; Poppler first if needed.
ui.ocr_install_source: Source: conda-forge packages (each one is checked) and tessdata_fast 4.1.0 (SHA-256 verified), into the application's folder. No admin rights are needed.
ui.ocr_ottoman_note: There is no language pack for Ottoman Turkish; for Arabic-script texts choose Arabic (ara) or Persian (fas).
ui.wf_no_runs: This workflow has not been run yet.
ui.instruction_hint: Write it in plain language; no {{…}} needed: the texts of the steps connected to this one are added to it.
ui.references_hint: To put a text at a given place in the instruction; usually not needed.
ui.node_simple_ai_cli: Write what the model should do. The texts of the steps connected to this one are added by themselves.
ui.node_simple_ai_map: Splits the text into parts, applies your instruction to each part and joins the answers in order.
ui.node_simple_condition: Picks one of two branches with a question: the Yes branch runs when the answer is yes, else the No branch.
ui.node_simple_text_merge: Joins the incoming texts in order.
ui.node_simple_document_extract: Reads the text of the file given in the run form. Text recognition for scanned pages: Advanced settings.
ui.node_simple_document_export: Saves the incoming text as a document in the formats you choose.
ui.node_simple_approval: Shows the incoming text to a person; approved, the flow goes on; rejected, this branch stops.
ui.file_input_hint: The file asked for when the workflow runs. A new input is added to the workflow's Inputs tab.
ui.condition_question: When should the flow take the Yes branch?
ui.poppler_first_line: First the conda-forge installer micromamba and the PDF reader Poppler are installed.
ui.typst_about: Makes PDF files in the Export document step (format: pdf). Supports Turkish and Arabic text.
ui.typst_install_what: Typst {version} and the Amiri font for Arabic script (SIL Open Font License).
ui.typst_install_source: Source: the official release archives on GitHub (typst/typst, aliftype/amiri); their SHA-256 checksums are verified. No admin rights are needed.
ui.pandoc_about: Optional converter: saves EPUB, turns $...$ formulas into Word equations, reads .odt and .rtf files. Without it, Mehteran's own Word converter is used.
ui.pandoc_install_source: Source: the official release archive on GitHub (jgm/pandoc); its SHA-256 checksum is verified. No admin rights are needed.
ui.speech_about: Writes down what is said in audio and video files, on this computer (the Extract document text step: mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, mp4, webm...). Nothing is sent anywhere.
ui.speech_install_what: whisper.cpp {version}, ffmpeg {ffmpeg} (when the computer has none) and the 'base' speech model.
ui.speech_install_source: Source: conda-forge packages (each one is checked) and the official whisper.cpp models on Hugging Face (SHA-256 verified), into the application's folder. No admin rights are needed.
ui.speech_models_note: All are multilingual (Turkish included). A larger model is more accurate but slower; base is enough for most work.
ui.qpdf_about: Repairs damaged or encrypted (opening without a password) PDFs: when the Extract document text step cannot read a PDF, it reads the copy that qpdf repaired.
ui.qpdf_install_source: Source: the conda-forge package (checked), into the application's folder. No admin rights are needed.
ui.usage_none: Mehteran has not called a model with this tool yet.
ui.usage_unknown: Unknown: the tool has not reported it.
ui.usage_codex_note: Codex writes its limits only into its own session logs; they appear here after you use Codex yourself once.
ui.usage_check_note: Asks Claude Code for its own usage report. No model call is needed; an older Claude Code gets one very short call.
ui.usage_left_none: This tool does not report its remaining usage.
ui.usage_left_local: Runs on this computer: no usage limit.
ui.usage_left_note: The tools report these values themselves. Mehteran asks Claude Code every few minutes without a model call. Codex writes its value when you use Codex.
ui.switch_waiting_hint: {model} is at its usage limit. Wait, or continue this step with another model; finished parts are kept.
ui.switch_failed_hint: This step did not finish with {model}. You can run it again with another model.
ui.log_empty: This step wrote nothing to its log.
ui.copy_select: The log is selected; copy it with Ctrl+C / ⌘C.
ui.same_as_last_hint: Models, language, choices and texts; not the files.
ui.last_filled: The values of the last run are filled in.
ui.fallback_provider_hint: Off when empty. When this step's model reaches its usage limit, the step continues with this model instead of waiting.
ui.language_input_hint: Shown in the run window as a list of languages with flags; every language is offered. Its value is the language code (tr, en, ar…).
ui.footer_local: Local-first: your files stay on this computer; they go only to the model tool you choose.
ui.footer_path_copied: The data folder's path was copied.
ui.footer_updates: Updates come with the launcher (Open Mehteran / ./mehter ui).
ui.footer_stale: The code was updated: restart the server.
ui.welcome_title: What would you like to do?
ui.welcome_intro: Start with one choice. All workflows are in the library below.
ui.welcome_document_text: Upload a document and get it explained in plain language. The library also has workflows that summarize a document or answer questions about it.
ui.welcome_writing_text: An e-mail reply, an official letter, a CV and cover letter, social media posts; rewriting and proofreading a text.
ui.welcome_data_text: Have a spreadsheet or survey answers analysed; get the findings and an analysis plan as a report.
ui.welcome_education_text: Make practice questions and exams from lecture notes; score the answers and get the mistakes explained.
ui.welcome_research_text: A review of a paper or a thesis chapter, a literature synthesis, a grant proposal review.
ui.welcome_install_failed: The install did not finish; the details are on the Setup tab.
ui.welcome_no_tool: The needed tool is not known. See the Setup tab.
ui.welcome_setup_link: Open on the Setup tab (API key, details)
ui.estimate_conditional: Steps after a condition: {count}. Such a step runs only when its branch is taken.
ui.estimate_no_cost: The tools do not tell how much of a usage limit one call takes, so no percentage per run is shown.
ui.edit_note: The original result does not change; the edited version is saved separately in the run's folder: {path}
ui.edit_saved: The edited version is saved. The original result is unchanged.
ui.edit_too_big: This result is too large to edit here (at most {limit} KB).
ui.export_hint: Saves the edited version in the chosen format and downloads it.
ui.compare_none: This workflow has no other finished run. Run it once more, then compare.
ui.compare_missing: This run has no such result.
ui.compare_same: The two results are the same.
ui.new_name_hint: Write only the name; you can change it later.
ui.new_id_hint: It is the file's name; it is made from the name and does not change after the first save.
ui.warnings_found: {count} warnings: it runs, but have a look
ui.starters_title: How do you want to start?
ui.starters_text: Pick a starter, or click one of the steps on the left. You can change everything later.
ui.starter_document_text: You upload a file; the model works on it; the result is saved.
ui.starter_text: A text I type → AI → Save
ui.starter_text_text: You type or paste a text; the model works on it; the result is saved.
ui.starter_describe: Describe it, I will build it
ui.starter_describe_text: Write what you want; a model writes the first draft of the workflow.
ui.starter_document_prompt: Read this document and summarise its most important points as short, clear bullet points. Add nothing that is not in the document.
ui.starter_text_prompt: Rewrite the text below in clearer and more correct language. Do not change its meaning.
ui.describe_title: Describe it, I will build it
ui.describe_lib_intro: Write in your own words what you want to do. Your installed tools build the workflow and save it; you see and can correct the instruction of every step. Nothing runs by itself.
ui.describe_saved: "{name}" is built and saved. Give the inputs and run it.
ui.describe_intro: Write in your own words what the workflow should do. A model writes the first draft; it opens in the editor and nothing runs by itself.
ui.describe_placeholder: What do you give it (a file, a text), what is done, what comes out at the end?
ui.describe_example_1: I upload meeting notes; it lists the decisions and a table of who does what until when.
ui.describe_example_2: I upload a contract; it finds the clauses that could be against me and writes what I should ask about each.
ui.describe_example_3: I paste an e-mail I wrote; it writes a more polite and shorter version, then checks its tone.
ui.describe_model: The model that writes the draft
ui.describe_one_call: This makes one call to the model you choose (one more to repair it when the first answer does not pass the check). What you write is sent to that tool.
ui.describe_working: The model is writing the draft… This can take a few minutes.
ui.describe_cancelled: Stopped. Your text is still here.
ui.describe_failed: The draft could not be written.
ui.describe_replace_confirm: The editor has unsaved changes. Open the draft in their place?
ui.describe_done: The draft is ready. It is not saved; check its steps.
ui.describe_done_invalid: The model could not write a valid workflow; you see its text and the problems on the YAML tab.
ui.draft_by: {model} wrote this. Check the instruction of every step, then run it.
ui.draft_invalid: {model} wrote this, but the draft did not pass the check. The problems:
ui.try_step_hint: Only this step runs; nothing is saved.
ui.try_needs_valid: Fix the problems of the workflow first; then you can test the step.
ui.try_source: The text of the steps before it
ui.try_no_run: This workflow has no run in which the steps before this one finished.
ui.try_sample_placeholder: Paste an example of the text that the step before would give.
ui.try_note: One call is made to the chosen model; it counts against your usage limit.
ui.mine_empty: Your own workflows, the ones you starred and the ones you ran last appear here. There are none yet: start from a template.
ui.saved_run_version: This run uses the workflow saved in the selected history entry. Choose input files again.
ui.node_simple_video_check: Check the topics and local video tools before the first model call.
ui.node_simple_video_preview: Listen to the first sentence before rendering.
ui.node_simple_video_series: Render narrated MP4 videos with burned-in captions from the approved scenes.
ui.node_simple_expense_validate: Check expense tables before producing the report.
ui.usage_prune_old: Also delete usage records older than the selected period
ui.run_disk_full: There is not enough free disk space to copy the input files.
ui.run_storage_limit: Run storage has reached the configured limit of {gib} GiB.
ui.run_storage_sensitive: Run folders may contain sensitive inputs, prompts and intermediate results.
ui.run_trash_text: Move this run to Trash. You can restore it until old runs are permanently cleaned up.
ui.quota_policy_wait: Without an available alternative, the step waits for up to {hours} hours.
ui.quota_policy_auto: Automatic model choices can switch to the next available model when a usage limit is reached.
ui.switch_cloud_confirm: Switching to {provider} will send this step’s text to an external provider.
ui.runs_cleanup_none: There is no finished run older than {days} days.
ui.runs_cleanup_confirm: {count} finished runs older than {days} days and their files ({size}) will be deleted.
ui.runs_delete_note: This cannot be undone. Results saved to a folder and the workflows are not deleted; runs that are working are kept.
ui.run_label_hint: Shown in the list instead of the workflow's name. Left empty, the workflow's name stays.
ui.run_delete_busy: This run has not finished or is working now; stop it first.
ui.run_delete_text: The run will be deleted with its inputs and results ({size}).
ui.output_waiting: When the run succeeds, its results will also be saved to: {path}
ui.output_failed: The results could not be saved to {path}: {error}
ui.batch_summary: {count} files chosen (at most {max}); one run per file, at most {parallel} at a time.
ui.batch_none: Choose the files of the batch.
ui.batch_many: A batch can have at most {max} files.
ui.estimate_batch: For {runs} runs: {calls} calls · with retries at most {max}
ui.output_save: Also save the results to this folder
ui.output_hint: Type the full path of the folder. The results are copied only when the run succeeds; a file with the same name is never overwritten: (2) is added to the name.
ui.output_confirm_text: Mehteran will copy the results of this workflow into: {path}
ui.output_confirm_note: This is asked only once; the folder is remembered for this workflow.
ui.output_not_confirmed: The folder was not confirmed; the run did not start.
ui.share_text: The workflow downloads as one .mehteran.yaml file; someone else can drop it on their library to import it. The file holds no password or key.
ui.import_empty: Choose a file or paste the YAML text first.
ui.preview_lede: Look at what this workflow will do before you add it: its steps, inputs, the tools it needs and every instruction it sends to the models are below.
ui.preview_exists: This id ({id}) is already used. It is added under a new id:
ui.preview_needs: What it needs, and its state here
ui.preview_web: Reads web pages (the address you give; addresses of this computer and the local network are not read).
ui.preview_needs_none: No model or extra tool is needed.
ui.drop_not_yaml: Only a workflow file (.yaml, at most 1 MB) can be dropped.
ui.auto_none_ui: No tool can be chosen automatically now (Setup tab).
ui.auto_none_local_ui: No local model now (Setup tab: Ollama).
ui.billed_warning: This tool runs on an API key: every call is billed.
ui.privacy_local_hint: the text does not leave this computer; with another tool chosen, the run does not start
ui.privacy_local_fixed: this workflow always runs on local models only
ui.sent_to_title: Steps and where the text goes
ui.providers_intro: The automatic model choice uses the first usable model of the order below. Tools that bill an API key are never chosen automatically.
ui.order_note: When a model reaches its usage limit, an automatic step moves to the next model.
ui.order_default_note: This is the default order, made from the installed tools. When you change it, your order is saved.
ui.order_empty: The order has no model: first install and sign in to a tool on the Setup tab.
ui.auto_explain: Fast: the tool's fast model or a low thinking level. Strong: its strong model or a high level. Local: only models on this computer (Ollama's cloud models do not count). The choice is made when a run starts and is kept with the run.
ui.key_dropped: An API key is set in the environment; Mehteran does not pass it to the tool.
ui.providers_file_note: These settings are kept in Mehteran's own file: <data>/configurations/providers.toml (no secrets).
ui.config_note_workflows: Workflows use Mehteran's own tool settings (below). Tools given by their command and the time limits are read from {path} (never changed).
ui.local_server_intro: If LM Studio, llama.cpp (llama-server) or vLLM runs on this computer, enter its address. Only an address on this computer is accepted (127.0.0.1, localhost); the text does not leave it.
ui.local_server_down: The server does not answer now.
ui.every_step_hint: Runs every step of this workflow with one tool, whatever the workflow sets. Useful when you have only one of the AI tools (for example only Codex).
ui.browser_about: Lets a Browser agent step open and read sites (and, after an approval, fill in forms) with Google Chrome and a Chrome profile of Mehteran's own. Needs Node.js and Google Chrome; works with Claude Code.
ui.browser_install_title: Install the browser for agent steps?
ui.browser_install_what: Playwright MCP {version} (Microsoft), with the exact package versions and integrity checksums of Mehteran's lock file.
ui.browser_install_source: Source: the npm registry (npm ci --ignore-scripts: no install scripts run). It uses your Google Chrome; no browser is downloaded. No admin rights are needed.
ui.browser_signin_note: Agent steps use this profile, not your own Chrome profile: {path}. Open it, sign in to the sites the steps need (for example X), then close the window before a run starts.
ui.browser_signin_open: Open the browser to sign in
ui.browser_signin_opened: Chrome opened with Mehteran's profile. Close it when you are done.
ui.share_on_x_hint: X opens with the post filled in; read it and press Post yourself.
ui.node_simple_ai_agent: Opens the sites you name in Mehteran's Chrome and does the task there: reads, or (after an approval) types and sends. Every action goes to the log.
ui.node_simple_share_x: Gives a link that opens X with the post filled in; you read it and press Post yourself.
ui.schedule_on: Run on a schedule instead of now
ui.schedule_hint: The inputs above are saved with the schedule. Runs start only while Mehteran is open; turn on “Run in the background” under Setup to keep it open. Approval steps wait for you, and a notification tells you.
ui.schedule_needs_files: This workflow needs a file, so it cannot be scheduled.
ui.schedule_delete_text: No more runs start from it. Its past runs stay in the history.
ui.background_about: Mehteran starts by itself when you sign in to this computer, with no window, so that scheduled runs start on time. Open it at http://127.0.0.1:8766/ (or with ./mehter ui) whenever you like.
ui.background_this: This page is served by the background server.
ui.background_waiting: This window is a Mehteran started by hand. The background server takes over when you close it.
ui.background_on_later: Background turned on. It takes over when you close this Mehteran.
ui.background_stop_text: This page is served by it, so the page stops working. Runs that are going on stop too and can be resumed later. Start Mehteran again with ./mehter ui.
ui.background_unsupported: Running in the background is not available on this system.
ui.built_intro: The model wrote the instruction of every step. Look at them and correct them if needed; then give the inputs and run it.
ui.built_change_placeholder: What should change? For example: make it shorter
ui.built_change_invalid: The change did not pass the check; the workflow stays as it was.
ui.describe_auto_line: Chosen automatically from your installed tools: {name}
ui.run_options_hint: The models are chosen automatically; saving to a folder and scheduling are here too.
ui.stale_manual: This server cannot restart itself; restart it once by hand as written above.
ui.privacy_local_web: This workflow reads sites in the browser with Claude Code; it cannot run with only the models on this computer.
ui.experimental_note: Works, but depends on websites or paid services that change often. Check the result before you use it; the video series needs paid OpenAI and ElevenLabs keys.
ui.unattended_label: Allow subscriptions and free accounts for scheduled and batch runs
ui.unattended_note: Off (recommended): these runs use only local models and tools with an API key. The providers' consumer terms do not clearly allow automated use of a subscription; you are responsible for your account's use.
ui.primary_title: Which AI account do you have?
ui.primary_intro: Mehteran does the work with this account. Choose one; you can add others later.
ui.primary_none_hint: A free model that runs on this computer; slower, needs enough memory
ui.primary_later: Not sure? Choose the account that you already pay for. You can change it later.
ui.installing_needed: Installing what this account needs. This takes a few minutes; keep this page open.
ui.step_signin_one: Click the button: a window and a sign-in page in your browser open. Sign in there; this page updates by itself.
ui.step_model_done: A model is on this computer
ui.step_model_hint: The model is downloaded once (1–5 GB); then it works without the internet.
